{{Infobox auto}}
The '''rusty axe''' is a damaged iron axe found by brushing suspicious gravel in cold and warm [[Ocean ruins|ocean ruins]].

== Obtaining ==
{{Sources}}
It always has 140 damage taken, and otherwise has the vanilla iron axe's stats (9 damage, 0.9 attack speed).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/archaeology/ocean_ruin_cold.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/equipment/misc/rusty_axe.json}}</ref> Since 1.12.4 both ocean ruin tables give it through the shared table <code>matcha:equipment/misc/rusty_axe</code>. Its name is plain text rather than a translatable name.
